### Start with Compassion
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-october-7-2022.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 9:19
Points:
- Today many people lack basic biblical literacy and familiarity with Scripture.
- Effective evangelism requires adapting our communication to the background of the listener.
- Sharing faith should be a two-way dialogue rather than a one-sided monologue.
- Demonstrating genuine care and compassion must precede sharing knowledge.

### How to Make Connections for Christ
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-1-2012.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 9:22
Points:
- Christians must actively look for creative avenues to engage with their surrounding culture.
- Ordinary community events can serve as effective platforms to expose people to the gospel.
- Believers should avoid isolation and instead build intentional connections with neighbors and peers.
- Any methodology that bridges the gap to non-believers can lead to eternal impact.
